assessment.summary: This study evaluated the molecular diversity of genes related to biological rhythms (period and timeless) and insecticide resistance (NaV and ace-1) in Anopheles darlingi populations from Brazil and Colombia. A total of 516 specimens were analyzed. The researchers found that the classical kdr (Vgsc L1014F/S) and ace-1R (G119S) mutations were absent in the sampled populations.
exclusion_reasons: The study was conducted on field populations from Brazil and Colombia (South America), not Africa.
